newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Western banks to lend Russia's Menatep $25 mln.
newsitem.headline: Western banks to lend Russia's Menatep $25 mln.

text.p: A consortium of Western banks led by Austria's Creditanstalt-Bankverein plans to grant a $25 million credit to one of Russia's biggest banks, Bank Menatep, a Creditanstalt official said on Tuesday.
"The deal was closed last week and the agreement will be signed in mid-December," assistant manager corporate and trade finance department Thomas Schirmer told Reuters.
Creditanstalt is the arranger of the credit and Berliner Bank AG and Bayerische Vereinsbank AG are co-arrangers, he said.
Other banks in the consortium are from Germany, Slovakia and the Czech Republic, he said.
Menatep will use the funds at its own wish, he said.
Schirmer also said Creditanstalt was in talks with other Russian banks on granting them credits.
Creditanstalt is a member of a consortium which on Tuesday signed an agreement to grant $85 million credit to AKB Tokobank.
